releaseNotes:
- Saving Settings now replaces this project's .gitignore, so removed ignore lines stay gone
- Direct Upload Git menu shows Remove from .gitignore when the path is already ignored
- Settings Git list has a Remove button per ignore line (same project file)
- Closing the local editor after Save changes no longer freezes the Deploy page
- Editor toolbar Save / Revert / Float use amber when active so Dark mode is readable
